findings.description: The tool declares filesystem or network access broader than its handler uses.
findings.remediation: Narrow each declared scope to the resources the handler actually requires.

evidence_refs.claim: `broad_reader` declares a path parameter but reads only the hardcoded `data/users.json` path.

review.reasoning: The declared `path` input is broader than the demonstrated implementation need: the function ignores it and always reads a fixed file.

findings.title: Overly broad tool permission scope

findings.description: Tool-controlled input reaches an unsafe execution or deserialization sink.
findings.remediation: Replace dynamic execution with explicit parsers and fixed command allowlists.

evidence_refs.claim: The tool accepts expression and passes it directly to eval without restricting or safely parsing its contents.

review.reasoning: The declared string input reaches Python eval directly after only type and length checks, enabling unsafe expression execution.

findings.title: Unsafe execution from tool input

findings.description: A tool handler consumes parameters before framework or explicit validation.
findings.remediation: Use an official input schema or explicit validation before first use.

evidence_refs.claim: The function directly reads `record_id` from the arguments object without validating its type.

review.reasoning: The tool schema validates only that `arguments` is an object and permits arbitrary nested properties. The function uses `arguments["record_id"]` without a schema-declared type or an explicit runtime type check.

findings.title: Missing tool input validation

findings.description: Tool output or description flows into a later model prompt without a trusted sanitizer.
findings.remediation: Pass tool-controlled text through a configured sanitizer before prompt construction.

evidence_refs.claim: Content returned by remote_tool is embedded directly into an instruction string.

review.reasoning: Tool-controlled content is interpolated directly into a model-style instruction prompt without sanitization.

findings.title: Unsanitized tool content in prompt

findings.description: Source or configuration contains a credential signature or contextual high-entropy secret.
findings.remediation: Load credentials from an external secret store or environment at runtime.

evidence_refs.claim: The source line is marked as containing a redacted secret.

review.reasoning: The supplied line is explicitly redacted as a detected secret, corroborating a hardcoded credential.

findings.title: Hardcoded secret

findings.description: An HTTP route lacks inherited authentication or uses a no-op verifier.
findings.remediation: Require credential verification and an explicit rejection path before route execution.

evidence_refs.claim: An /admin POST route is declared, but no authentication context is supplied.

review.reasoning: The route declaration is shown, but the supplied context omits its handler and any application-level authentication controls, so effective authentication cannot be determined.

findings.title: Missing or ineffective route authentication

findings.description: Manifest bytes reach registration without a trusted hash or signature verification.
findings.remediation: Verify a pinned SHA-256 digest or trusted detached signature before parsing and use.

evidence_refs.claim: tools.yaml is read and loaded directly with yaml.safe_load.

review.reasoning: The manifest is opened and parsed directly without any visible signature, digest, or other integrity verification.

findings.title: Unverified tool manifest

findings.description: After a successful granted-tool control, the server processed valid arguments through a listed tool omitted from its declared tool-name grants.
findings.remediation: Reject tool calls that are not granted by the active capability policy.

evidence_refs.claim: SENT-008 records violation_observed for ungranted_echo with is_error false.

review.reasoning: The out-of-scope ungranted_echo call produced a violation verdict and completed without error.

findings.title: Out-of-scope tool execution

findings.description: After a successful baseline, the server processed an explicit size-limit violation or suffered an observed OOM/crash on an oversized argument.
findings.remediation: Enforce schema and byte-size limits before invoking tool handlers.

evidence_refs.claim: SENT-009 records a measured size of 1,048,558 against maxLength 4096, violation_observed, and is_error false.

review.reasoning: The tool accepted an oversized expression despite the declared 4096-character maximum and returned without error.

findings.title: Oversized argument violates a limit or crashes the target

findings.description: A tool argument caused the Sentinel scratch canary side effect.
findings.remediation: Treat tool arguments as inert data and remove dynamic execution sinks.

evidence_refs.claim: SENT-010 records canary_after true and violation_observed for unsafe_calculator.expression.

review.reasoning: The inert injection probe changed the execution canary from false to true, directly demonstrating unexpected execution.

findings.title: Injection payload executed

findings.description: After a successful baseline, the server processed locally verified invalid arguments that violate a required-field or type constraint.
findings.remediation: Validate required fields and declared types before handler execution.

evidence_refs.claim: SENT-011 records a type constraint violation, violation_observed, and is_error false.

review.reasoning: The tool accepted a wrong-type value despite the expression field's declared string type and returned without error.

findings.title: Malformed schema input processed
